criteria.V1_method_invention: net D-only minus Dq-only >= 10, exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.05, D-only tasks from >= 2 structure classes
criteria.V2_latent_state_discovery: >= 5 FRESH tasks solved by D with an accepted machine of m >= 2 components that Dq does not solve
criteria.V3_learned_policy: E vs D: E-only >= 5 and McNemar p < 0.05, or solved(E) >= solved(D) with total CPU(E) <= 0.7 x CPU(D)
criteria.reported_separately: tasks solved ONLY through a new latent component: the adopted predictor is a machine with m >= 2 components and neither A nor Dq solves the task (D and E separately); also every D / E solve with m >= 2
criteria.unresolved: tasks whose reference fails its own published tests (T3) are reported and not run; error rows count as unsolved for D/E and solved for rivals

development_evidence_not_counted: list-routines dev re-test (228 tasks, same code): see docs/research/Q3_ACTIVE_STRUCTURAL_DISCOVERY_2026_11_13.md section 7
